method: Landmarks via visual grounding on extracted frames (0-1000 coords, converted to px). skull = midpoint(eye, back-of-head) for proportion frames; head-centre grounding for strike sequences. torso = max pairwise distance among tail-tip / chest-front / back-top / belly points (hull-diameter analogue of STRIKE_MEASURE's eroded-torso hull; posture-dependent, +-14% cross-check in the stills study). chord_base = |skull - neck-base-entry|; chord76 = distance to the point at 76% of centreline arc (STRIKE_MEASURE's station-1 definition); at full extension chord76 ~= 0.78 x chord_base (near-straight neck).
